document.summary: The next skill adds lookFor cases for identity traces, production hunks in test PRs, and setup scripts that delete developer files. Mechanical summaries must say when generated output means the same. Unasked enabling work stays one harness part. The `.agents` copy is identical.
document.why: [#117](source:s2) asks to iterate the skill until reviews match the expected outcomes. Grok 4.6 high is the producer, and [#118](source:s3) still missed identity changes, setup-script deletes, generated meaning, and extra harness parts.

commits.subject: Skill: catch hidden identity, setup side effects, and skip-safe generated files
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Grok 4.6 high already follows the source-verdict and grouping rules from #118.
The remaining misses were equality changes in production hunks, setup scripts
that delete developer files, generated output that means the same, invented
lookFor examples, and unasked harness clusters each getting their own part.

Co-authored-by: doglotteger <doglotteger@gmail.com>
